## Summary

Describe the problem and the chosen solution.

## Verification

List the builds, tests, and manual scenarios run. Add screenshots for UI or theme
changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include generated or local files.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Relevant CMake presets build and their tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation was updated for user-visible or extension API changes.
- [ ] Dependency changes are reflected in notices and the SBOM.
- [ ] Logs and screenshots contain no credentials or private information.
